field.label: Enable
field.help: Run the Cloudflare Tunnel and start it automatically at boot. Apply changes to update the running service.

field.label: Mode
field.help: Choose how the tunnel is defined. Token mode connects a Cloudflare-managed tunnel using a token from the Zero Trust dashboard, where you also set its public hostnames and routes; local ingress rules are not used. Config File mode defines the tunnel on this firewall and routes traffic with the rules on the Ingress Rules tab.

field.label: Tunnel Token
field.help: Paste the tunnel token from an existing remotely-managed tunnel. Required in Token mode. See Cloudflare Tunnel permissions: https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/networks/connectors/cloudflare-tunnel/configure-tunnels/remote-tunnel-permissions/

field.label: Tunnel Name
field.help: Optional local label for the tunnel. Config File mode uses the Tunnel ID below as the runtime tunnel identity.

field.label: AccountTag
field.help: Paste the AccountTag value from the tunnel credentials JSON created by cloudflared tunnel create. Cloudflare also returns these values in the API response credentials_file object. Required in Config File mode. See Cloudflare locally-managed tunnel setup: https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/networks/connectors/cloudflare-tunnel/do-more-with-tunnels/local-management/create-local-tunnel/

field.label: Tunnel ID
field.help: Paste the TunnelID value from the same tunnel credentials JSON. Config File mode writes this UUID into config.yml.

field.label: Tunnel Secret
field.help: Paste the TunnelSecret value from the same tunnel credentials JSON. Required in Config File mode.

field.label: Post-Quantum
field.help: Use post-quantum cryptography for tunnel connections. Keep this on unless an older environment has trouble connecting.

field.label: Edge IP Version
field.help: Prefer IPv4, prefer IPv6, or let Cloudflare choose when connecting to its edge.

field.label: Protocol
field.help: Transport protocol between cloudflared and the Cloudflare edge. Auto works best for most setups.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Amount of detail written to the cloudflared log. Use Info for normal operation, and Debug only while troubleshooting.
